summary_en: Correction to tender offer filing. Special relationship parties' shareholding adjusted from 39.02% to 40.65% pre-acquisition due to change in affiliated holders. Muninova to acquire 10,984,018 Ansin Hosho shares, reaching 63.16% post-transaction. Warrant acquisition also included (6th series, exercise period to 2026-08-09).
title_en: Correction notice: partial amendment to the 'Notice regarding the commencement of a tender offer for common shares of Ansin Hosho Co., Ltd. (TSE Standard Market, security code 7183)' filed with the Kanto Financial Bureau on 2026-06-18
translation_en_brief: This is a correction filing (訂正届出) by Muninova Holdings to amend a tender offer announcement for Ansin Hosho Co., Ltd. (TSE Standard Market, code 7183), originally filed 2026-05-12. The correction updates shareholding disclosures following a change in affiliated parties (特別関係者): the aggregate holdings of Muninova's special relationship parties (related entities and individuals) are now stated at 40.65% pre-acquisition (previously 39.02%), as Masashi Masui (増井啓司氏) has been added to the list of acquisition targets alongside AG Capital. The offer itself remains unchanged: Muninova intends to acquire 10,984,018 ordinary shares of Ansin Hosho, which would result in a 63.16% ownership stake post-transaction. The offer also covers the company's 6th series warrants (with exercise period through 2026-08-09). The amendment does not constitute a change in the tender offer conditions under the Financial Instruments and Exchange Act.
